Data exploration¶

These figures show the full dataset (all 1503 rows, including the test hold-out) before any model is fitted. They are written to doc/generated/ by src/explore_plots.py. To update this page:

python src/explore_plots.py --no-show
sphinx-build -b html doc doc/_build/html
